recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No core source follow-up is recommended unless the work group reopens the broader policy question of limiting Composition to documents.
issue_request: FHIR-7968 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Structured Documents request titled 'Limit Scope of Composition Resource to Documents.' The proposed text would have removed EN 13606 examples as valid Composition uses and suggested a separate Note resource, but the final resolution instead required clarifying the EN 13606 sentence while keeping the reference.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 6202. Git commit 83f8cf385936b176fec04e2abaaa266cb7dc261e matches that revision and rewrote source/composition/composition-introduction.xml to describe EN 13606 examples as compositions containing notes or reports, keep attested EHR commit as a valid Composition use, and recommend more granular FHIR updates with individual Provenance statements.
additional_context: Composition is active in source/fhir.ini and the current narrative plus StructureDefinition distinguish general Composition grouping from document use. Related Composition decisions already on the combined branch, including FHIR-13426, FHIR-25438, and FHIR-12963, confirm that current Composition scope is intentionally broader than documents and that document-principles wording should not become a document-only restriction.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active source already conveys the modified FHIR-7968 resolution, and changing it to literally limit Composition to documents would conflict with later accepted Composition scope decisions.
